initial-d-haruna-day.winterNote: Road is open in winter, but it is at high altitude with snow and ice risk Dec–Mar. Studless tyres are a must; both can drive a normal rental car; Aoki takes the icy parts. Go only on a clear day. Add Usui pass (Route 18, Megane Bridge) if time allows.

plan-car-road-trip.winterNote: Lake Megami ice sessions ran Jan 19–20 and Feb 6–7 in 2026; 2027 dates not yet found. Haruna and Akagi roads freeze in winter: studless tyres needed, go only in daylight and dry weather. Pegasis can drive normal rental cars (Times has no minimum years); only JDM sports-car shops need 3+ years.

tohoku-rental-car.winterNote: Mountain roads in heavy snow and possible whiteouts; drive only in daylight. Hachimantai Aspite Line and the Towada–Hakkoda road beyond Sukayu (N103/N394 sections) close in winter; use open routes only and check road info (JARTIC) the day before. Both can drive a normal rental car; the more snow-experienced driver takes the mountain parts. Towada winter festival (2026: 30 Jan–23 Feb, closed Tue–Thu) starts after these dates.
